kept.title: Sidewalk clearing timing after snow
kept.detail: The City starts clearing sidewalks once snow reaches 2 cm, and crews typically finish a full clearing cycle within about 12 hours. Early-morning or late-night walks soon after a snowfall may happen before clearing reaches a given sidewalk. The data does not show whether these stops are on the TTC priority list for clearing.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.
the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.

kept.title: Laneways are salted but not plowed
kept.detail: In winter, public laneways are only salted, within 24 hours after snowfall ends. They are not plowed. Any walking route that uses a laneway may have snow left on it.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
